bib.title: Scaling Autoregressive Models for Content-Rich Text-to-Image Generation

read.skipped: reference list skimmed only; figure-only content (images, bar charts) not readable

question: Can a scaled two-stage autoregressive encoder-decoder Transformer over ViT-VQGAN image tokens match or beat diffusion models at open-domain text-to-image generation, and where does it fail?
hypothesis: Scaling autoregressive text-to-image models (as with LLMs) gives consistent gains in image quality, text-image alignment and world knowledge.
contributions: Autoregressive models reach state-of-the-art: 7.23 zero-shot and 3.22 finetuned FID on MS-COCO, 15.97 zero-shot and 8.39 finetuned FID on Localized Narratives
Scale matters: the 20B model is best at photo-realism and content-rich synthesis with complex composition and world knowledge
PartiPrompts (P2) benchmark of over 1600 prompts, the 'growing a cherry tree' concept, and a catalogued set of error types

method.summary: Parti is a two-stage model: a ViT-VQGAN tokenizer turns a 256x256 image into 1024 discrete tokens (8192-entry codebook), and an encoder-decoder Transformer (350M to 20B) maps text tokens to image tokens with next-token prediction. At inference it uses classifier-free guidance, samples 16 images per prompt and reranks with a CoCa model.

datasets.name: Training mix: LAION-400M, FIT400M (filtered subset of 1.8B ALIGN examples), JFT-4B
datasets.source: LAION-400M public; ALIGN-derived; JFT-4B with labels or SimVLM machine captions (random switch)
datasets.preprocessing: DALL-E dVAE input processing (tokenizer) and DALL-E Transformer input processing (encoder-decoder), per Ramesh et al. App. A.2 / B.2

datasets.name: Localized Narratives (COCO subset, LN-COCO)
datasets.size: 134K train, 8K val; 42.1 avg words per caption
datasets.split: val has 5,000 unique images, captions oversampled to 30,000

datasets.name: PartiPrompts (P2)
datasets.source: authored by the paper; about 7% curated from earlier papers

models.name: Parti-350M
models.architecture: encoder-decoder Transformer, conv-shaped masked sparse attention in decoder
models.tokenizer: SentencePiece 16,000 text vocab; ViT-VQGAN image tokens

models.name: Parti (20B)
models.init_from: text encoder pretrained (C4 BERT objective + contrastive on image-text data) by default

models.name: ViT-VQGAN tokenizer
models.params: about 30M (Small encoder/codebook); decoder finetuned to about 600M
models.architecture: ViT-VQGAN-Small: 8 blocks, 8 heads, dim 512, hidden 2048; larger decoder 32 blocks, 16 heads, dim 1280, hidden 5120

models.name: Retrieval baseline (EfficientNet-L2 ALIGN-based, ScaNN)
models.architecture: nearest training image by ALIGN text-image alignment

models.name: VL-T5 captioner
models.architecture: pretrained captioner used for captioner evaluation

training.objective: next-token prediction of rasterized image latent codes, softmax cross-entropy over 8192 image tokens, averaged over 1024 tokens
training.optimizer: Adafactor, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.96, first moments quantized float32 to int8, vectorized version for 20B
training.lr_schedule: exponential decay starting at step 85,000, final ratio 0.025
training.precision: bfloat16 for attention projection and feed-forward; layer norms and model output float32
training.dropout: 0.1 (encoder and decoder, all models; deterministic dropout in 20B)
training.regularisation: gradient norm clipped to 4.0; no EMA of weights; extra layer norm at encoder and decoder outputs
training.hardware: CloudTPUv4; Lingvo + GSPMD; 350M/750M data parallel; 3B 4-way in-layer model parallel + 128-way data parallel; 20B 16-stage pipelines for encoder and decoder + 64-way data parallel with 4-round circular schedule in decoder

other.450,000 steps: stated in Sec. 3 for the schedule; whether every size trained that long is not stated

inference.decoding: autoregressive sampling of 1024 image tokens, decoded by ViT-VQGAN decoder; classifier-free guidance on logits; best of 16 by CoCa score
inference.samples: 16 images per prompt, reranked by CoCa; single run, no seeds stated; FID uses 30,000 generated images
inference.prompting: free text prompts; some P2 figures append 'dslr photograph. daytime lighting.'

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: Frechet distance between Gaussians fit to Inception v3 pool features of 30,000 generated and real images, 256x256, pytorch-fid

metrics.name: Captioner evaluation
metrics.definition: generated image captioned by VL-T5; caption vs input prompt scored by BLEU, METEOR, CIDEr, SPICE

metrics.name: Human side-by-side
metrics.definition: each pair judged by 5 independent annotators for image realism and image-text match; majority vote = 3 or more of 5

baselines: DALL-E small, ruDALL-E-XL, minDALL-E, X-LXMERT (captioner eval)
eval.protocol: Automatic FID on 30,000 COCO-2014 val prompts; captioner eval on MS-COCO 5K test; human eval: 1,000 randomly sampled COCO prompts (each rated by 5 evaluators; Sec. 5.4 says 1,000 independent evaluators), and P2 for 20B vs 3B vs retrieval; no significance tests or seeds reported.

availability.data: PartiPrompts released with the paper; training data not released

evidence.quote: We use a default learning rate of 4.5e-5 and exponential learning rate schedule with 5,000 warm-up steps.

results.claim: Parti 20B reaches zero-shot FID 7.23 on MS-COCO, comparable to Imagen 7.27.
results.setup: MS-COCO 2014 val, 30,000 samples, 16 samples/prompt CoCa-reranked, guidance scale 1.2, zero-shot
results.quote: Parti achieves a comparable zero-shot FID score 7.23 compared with diffusion-based model Imagen [13].

results.claim: Finetuned Parti reaches FID 3.22 on MS-COCO, beating Make-A-Scene 7.55 and in-dataset retrieval 6.82.
results.setup: MS-COCO 2014 val, finetuned, same sampling and guidance
results.quote: Parti achieves state-of-the-art FID score of 3.22, a dramatic improvement over previous best ﬁnetuned FID 7.55 from an autoregressive model, Make-a-Scene [10].

results.claim: Zero-shot FID on MS-COCO falls with scale: 14.10 (350M), 10.71 (750M), 8.10 (3B), 7.23 (20B).
results.setup: Parti-3B zero-shot MS-COCO 2014; same data, tokenizer, CoCa reranker
results.note: Values for the other sizes (14.10, 10.71, 7.23) are read from the Fig 9 left panel text.

results.claim: LN-COCO zero-shot FID 15.97, nearly matching finetuned XMC-GAN 14.12.
results.quote: Moreover, Parti achieves a zero-shot FID score of 15.97, which nearly matches XMC-GAN’s ﬁnetuned score

results.claim: LN-COCO finetuned FID 8.39 (Table 5, abstract), against XMC-GAN 14.12 and retrieval 16.48.
results.table: Table 5, row Parti, column LN-COCO FID Finetuned
results.note: Prose in Sec 5.3 prints 8.29 for the same number; intro contributions print 8.39.

results.claim: Human raters prefer zero-shot Parti over finetuned XMC-GAN on MS-COCO: 91.7% image realism, 90.5% image-text match.
results.setup: 1,000 random MS-COCO 2014 val prompts, 5 raters each, zero-shot Parti 20B vs XMC-GAN
results.quote: 91.7% preference score for image realism and 90.5% for image-text match.

results.claim: Against the retrieval baseline on MS-COCO, Parti is worse on realism (45.2% vs 54.8%) but better on image-text match (55.2% vs 44.8%).
results.setup: 1,000 MS-COCO prompts, Parti 20B zero-shot vs retrieval over ~4B training images
results.quote: (45.2% compared to 54.8%) but evaluated as better on image-text match (55.2% compared to 44.8%).

results.claim: On P2, 20B is preferred over retrieval: 63.2% realism, 75.9% image-text match.
On P2, 20B is preferred over 3B: 56.8% realism, 62.7% image-text match.
Captioner evaluation on MS-COCO 5K: Parti BLEU 26.4, METEOR 23.9, CIDEr 83.9, SPICE 16.5, close to the retrieval baseline (84.1 CIDEr) and below ground truth (108.3).
results.setup: MS-COCO 5K test, VL-T5 captioner, 16 samples CoCa-reranked

results.claim: Retrieval baseline FID is worse than 30,000 random train images (2.47) because retrieval returns duplicates: only 17,782 unique images for 30,000 prompts.
results.setup: MS-COCO val prompts, retrieval over MS-COCO train
results.quote: there are only 17,782 unique retrieved MS-COCO train images for 30,000 validation text prompts

results.claim: Counting is reliable up to seven objects of one type; the reranker helps (top six of 'five red apples' all had five).
results.quote: Parti can reliably produce up to seven objects of the same type

results.claim: For 'ten red apples' the counts in the top-ranked eight images of one batch were 8, 10, 9, 9, 9, 8, 11, 6.
results.quote: the counts for the top-ranked eight images for one batch were 8, 10, 9, 9, 9, 8, 11, 6.

results.claim: Text-encoder pretraining only marginally helps the 3B model's training loss; the encoder degrades on GLUE after encoder-decoder training (CoLA 55.2 to 20.4 with pretraining).
results.setup: Table 9, 3B, encoder after encoder-decoder training with encoder pretraining
results.table: Table 9, row (w/ encoder pretraining), column CoLA

results.claim: 20B uses larger decoders: 64 decoder layers vs 16 encoder layers.
results.table: Table 1, row Parti, column Decoder Layers

results.claim: At 350M to 750M, encoder-decoder outperformed decoder-only variants in training loss and generation quality (early exploration, no numbers).
20B beats 3B on every P2 challenge aspect except BASIC, where 3B suffices; scaling mostly helps image-text match rather than realism.
results.setup: P2 human eval breakdown, Figs 12 and 26

limits: Models, code and data are not released, so nothing here is reproducible beyond the paper's description
Training compute, wall-clock, seeds, sampling temperature/top-k and the CF-guidance dropout probability are not stated
Human eval has no significance tests; Sec 5.4 says 1,000 independent evaluators for the same 1,000 prompts
FID is not a reliable ranking alone: Parti zero-shot looked far better than XMC-GAN by eye with similar FID
Failures: color bleeding, feature blending, counting beyond seven, spatial relations, negation, text rendering, strong visual and linguistic priors
Authors concede the training data are mostly uncurated web images with bias and NSFW issues; model not for generating people
Comparison with diffusion models is on FID only; no matched-compute comparison
2022 snapshot: later models (Imagen 2, Muse, SDXL) are not covered

terms.definition: an interactive process in which a prompter tests a prompt idea, evaluates the outputs, modifies the prompt and repeats, so that selected images result from exploring the model's capabilities
